title: Closest Guess
tagline: No choices. Type a number. Closest wins.
howTo: Every answer is a number, and there are no choices.
Type your best guess on your phone.
The closest guess gets 1,000 points and second closest gets 500. Spot on earns a 500 bonus.

questions.question: How many keys are on a standard piano?

How many states share a border with Pennsylvania?
questions.fact: New York, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland, West Virginia and Ohio.
